channel.title: Nordic Crypto
channel.description: नॉर्वे, स्वीडन, डेनमार्क, फ़िनलैंड और आइसलैंड से बिटकॉइन, ब्लॉकचेन और क्रिप्टो समाचार, अंग्रेज़ी सारांश, आयोजन कैलेंडर और “कौन क्या है” के साथ।

item.title: Avviser krypto-på-kammerset-påstand
item.description:
The industry association Norsk Datasenter Industri (NDI) rejects the claim that crypto mining is a well-known way for companies to get started in the data-centre business, Ságat reports. According to NDI's CEO Reynir Johannesson, it is not common in the Norwegian data-centre industry to start with crypto mining to fund a later shift to cloud services, storage or AI. The story is a follow-up to Ságat's earlier coverage of data-centre company Arctic Core's plans in Kautokeino; the rest of the article is behind a paywall.

स्रोत: Ságat

item.title: Canton går in i Sydkorea – vill tokenisera landets finansmarknad
item.description:
The Canton Foundation has signed a cooperation agreement with South Korean securities firm Meritz Securities to explore how traditional financial assets such as bonds can be tokenised and made available to institutional investors internationally, Kryptovalutaguiden reports. According to the article, the agreement signed on 15 October is a declaration of intent, meaning the parties will evaluate possible use cases rather than launch a finished service. Kryptovalutaguiden notes that how far the cooperation can go depends partly on South Korea's rules for digital securities.

स्रोत: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: Kryptokamp i Kautokeino: – Hvor vanlig er utvinning?
item.description:
SV MP Lars Haltbrekken has submitted a written question to digitalisation and public administration minister Torgeir Micaelsen (Labour) about how common crypto mining is, Altaposten reports in a story on a data-centre establishment in Kautokeino. The rest of the article is behind a paywall, so the content of the question and any answer are not visible.

स्रोत: altaposten.no

item.title: Gjennomføring av nivå 2-regelverk under MiCA
item.description:
Finanstilsynet has adopted an amendment to Norway's crypto-asset regulation (kryptoeiendelsforskriften) that implements Commission Regulation (EU) 2024/1504 in Norwegian law, the Norwegian FSA announces. The EU regulation sets procedural rules for how the European Banking Authority imposes fines or periodic penalty payments on issuers of significant asset-referenced tokens and significant e-money tokens. According to Finanstilsynet, the EEA Agreement adapts the regulation so that the EFTA Surveillance Authority (ESA) holds this power over firms established in the EEA/EFTA states.

स्रोत: Finanstilsynet

item.title: EU-tilsyn strammer grepet om kryptovalutaer
item.description:
European crypto companies are to stop offering services linked to stablecoins that do not comply with EU rules, Finanswatch reports under the headline that an EU supervisor is tightening its grip on cryptocurrencies. The rest of the article is behind a paywall, and the visible text does not say which stablecoins are affected or which document the requirement comes from.

स्रोत: Finanswatch

item.title: Den svenske Riksbanken ber Riksdagen forberede en digital krona
item.description:
In a letter to the Riksdag's Committee on Finance dated 7 October and published on 15 October, Sweden's Riksbank asks that work begin now on the legislation needed for a possible digital krona, Kaupr reports. The Riksbank cites the worsened security situation, plans for a digital euro and the growth of stablecoins, and estimates that an introduction would take at least five years on top of the legislative work. The Riksbank stresses that it has not taken a position on whether a digital krona should be introduced; it proposes that preparations start through a public inquiry, and any issuance would require the Riksdag's consent.

स्रोत: Kaupr

item.title: Turkkilaismedia: Suomen etsintäkuuluttama kryptomiljonääri otettu kiinni Turkissa
item.description:
Richard James Schueler, a US crypto millionaire wanted by Finland and also known as Richard Heart, has been detained in Istanbul, according to Turkish media; Yle reports this via STT, citing the Turkish site Daily Sabah and the IHA news agency. The arrest has so far been reported only by Turkish media. The Helsinki District Court remanded Schueler in custody in absentia in September 2024 as a suspect in aggravated tax fraud, and Hämeen Sanomat reports that Helsinki police suspect he avoided about €280 million in taxes in his crypto business.

स्रोत: Yle Uutiset

item.title: Kryptojätten köper bank med svenska sparkunder
item.description:
Payward, the US company behind crypto exchange Kraken, is buying Lithuania's Saldo Bank, which has held an EU banking licence since 2021 and offers savings accounts and other services to customers in countries including Sweden, Realtid reports, citing the Financial Times. According to the FT, the deal would make Payward the first company in the digital-asset sector to buy a bank in Europe, and the bank is meant to help it develop lending and payment cards. The acquisition requires regulatory approval and is expected to be completed in 2027.

स्रोत: Realtid

item.title: Datasentre betalte under 12 millioner skatt totalt: – Dette må det bores mer i
item.description:
Fewer than half of Norway's data-centre operators paid corporate tax for 2024, while crypto miners account for several of the largest tax contributions, Digi.no reports from a new overview. According to the visible part of the paywalled article, the list covers 55 operators and comes from an answer by digitalisation minister Torgeir Micaelsen to MP Lars Haltbrekken (SV).

स्रोत: Digi.no

item.title: Stablecoin-samarbeid med nordiske banker får godkjenning – lanserer om kort tid
item.description:
A company backed by 37 banks, including Nordic banks, has received an important authorisation and is preparing to launch blockchain-based euro tokens under the EU's MiCA rules, Finanswatch reports. According to the paywalled article's headline, the launch is expected shortly. The visible text does not give further details.

स्रोत: Finanswatch

item.title: Skattesmocka hotar tyska kryptosparare
item.description:
Germany is moving towards tax rules that are less favourable for crypto investments, EFN reports via the news agency Direkt, citing the German newspaper Wirtschaftswoche. According to the report, the government wants to abolish the tax exemption on gains from crypto held for more than a year and to apply a withholding tax instead of individual income tax, and the issue was expected on the agenda of a meeting on Wednesday. Industry representatives are critical of the planned changes.

स्रोत: efn

item.title: Spørsmål i Stortinget: – Nye datasenter utvinner krypto?
item.description:
A claim by data-centre company Arctic Core AS to Kautokeino municipality, that crypto is common and well known in the data-centre industry, is now the subject of a question in the Storting, the local paper Ságat reports. The story is a follow-up to Ságat's earlier report that Arctic Core acknowledged it would carry out 'a little' crypto mining in Kautokeino. The rest of the article is behind a paywall.

स्रोत: Ságat

item.title: Kryptovalutabörs stämd på över 260 miljoner kronor
item.description:
A software engineer has filed a claim in the UK against crypto exchange BitMEX, seeking £20 million (about SEK 264 million) for bitcoin said to have been lost on financial derivatives, Dagens PS reports, citing The Guardian. The claim alleges that BitMEX sold unregulated financial products to UK investors without authorisation from the Financial Conduct Authority, and that such contracts may therefore be void under UK law. HDR Global Trading, which owns BitMEX, declined to comment on the case, and a representative said the claim has not yet been formally served.

स्रोत: Dagens PS

item.title: Bitcoin presses av rekordstore uttak
item.description:
Exchange-traded bitcoin products saw net outflows of 10,064 bitcoin in five days, the largest since 15 September, as bitcoin fell from USD 86,000 to below USD 80,500, according to K33's weekly report as covered by Investornytt. K33's head of analysis attributes the fall mainly to a broader flight from risk. According to K33's weekly report, open positions in perpetual futures are at a five-month low, which makes forced liquidations unlikely, and K33 still considers bitcoin attractively priced with limited downside.

स्रोत: Investornytt

item.title: Frankrike vill beskatta kryptomiljonärer som flyttar utomlands
item.description:
Realtid reports, citing Euronews and Journal du Coin, that the French National Assembly's finance committee voted to extend the country's exit tax to crypto assets above EUR 800,000 from 2027, and backed fines of up to EUR 10,000 for undeclared self-custody wallets worth EUR 100,000 or more. The proposals are not yet law and may still fall.

स्रोत: Realtid

item.title: Bred enighed om ny kryptoskat: Forslaget har ligget i skuffen i over et år
item.description:
Børsen reports that a broad working group of authorities, business and the crypto industry agreed on a new crypto tax model more than a year ago, but the proposal has since been shelved. The government is now signalling new rules.

स्रोत: Børsen

item.title: Amerikansk finanspresse oppdager at tokenisering endrer børs og aksjehandel
item.description:
Kaupr summarises recent US financial press coverage, saying Barron's, the Wall Street Journal, CNBC and Bloomberg all wrote about stock tokenisation in early October. According to that coverage, tokenised shares could bring round-the-clock trading and faster settlement, and an ICE–OKX venture is preparing to tokenise stocks.

स्रोत: Kaupr

item.title: Krypto i Kautokeino: – Kommunen vært naiv
item.description:
In a follow-up to its earlier report that data-centre firm Arctic Core admits to 'a little' crypto mining on its site in Kautokeino, Ságat reports that the local Naturvernforbundet branch wants the municipality to withdraw the building permit. The group's complaint will not be handled before November, when it may be passed to the county governor.

स्रोत: Ságat

item.title: Manipulation: Kryptoplånböcker tömdes på 860 miljoner
item.description:
Dagens PS reports, citing The Verge, that a suspected supply-chain attack using a hidden circuit board in some Ledger hardware wallets may have let an attacker capture recovery phrases and drain accounts, with losses estimated at about USD 86 million. Ledger has confirmed an unauthorised hardware component in one affected user's device and asked the reseller involved to pause sales during an investigation.

स्रोत: Dagens PS

item.title: Spillpioner og kapitalforvalter satser sammen på tokenisering
item.description:
Kaupr reports, based on the companies' announcement at TOKEN2049 in Singapore, that games and Web3 company Animoca Brands and asset manager Franklin Templeton have entered a strategic partnership around NUVA, Animoca's marketplace for tokenised assets. According to the companies, they have also launched a four-part research series on tokenisation.

स्रोत: Kaupr

item.title: Aksjer på blokkjeden kan forsterke børsuro
item.description:
Investornytt reports that an IMF financial-stability chapter on tokenisation found price swings in its sample of tokenised stock products about 50 percent larger than in traditional markets, with notably weaker liquidity. The IMF warns that automatic forced sales could amplify market stress as the market grows.

स्रोत: Investornytt

item.title: AI kan tømme lommebøkene
item.description:
Investornytt reports that Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake believes AI could help break ECDSA, the signature scheme behind Bitcoin and Ethereum wallets, in the worst case within months, and suggests moving funds to addresses whose public key has not been exposed. Vitalik Buterin calls the risk serious but warns against panic.

स्रोत: Investornytt

item.title: Eksperimenterer med den norske kronen i internasjonal sandkasse
item.description:
FinFacts has interviewed DNB about its experiments with the Norwegian krone in an international sandbox for tokenised bank deposits. According to the article's lead, DNB believes tokenised bank deposits will play at least as important a role as stablecoins in shaping the digital money of the future. The full interview is behind a paywall.

स्रोत: FinFacts

item.title: Innrømmer «litt» kryptoutvinning
item.description:
Data-centre company Arctic Core now acknowledges that it will carry out 'a little' crypto mining in Kautokeino, the local paper Ságat reports. In writing, the company argues that using crypto mining to generate income during a test phase does not change the basic character of the warehouse building it has been granted a permit for. According to Ságat, the building is mainly meant for testing and storing equipment.

स्रोत: Ságat

item.title: 30 nya namn på varningslistan – akta dig för företagen
item.description:
Sweden's Finansinspektionen has warned against 30 more firms that look legitimate but lack a licence; several lure consumers with trading in shares, crypto and currencies, and some are clone firms using details of real financial companies. FI has now warned against 227 suspected investment-fraud operators so far in 2026 and urges people to check its company register before sending money.

स्रोत: Nyheter24

item.title: Amla föreslår tre tekniska standarder enligt penningtvättsförordningen
item.description:
The EU anti-money-laundering authority AMLA has sent three final draft technical standards under the new AML regulation to the European Commission, Sweden's Finansinspektionen reports; they still need the Commission's adoption. Under AMLA's report, crypto-asset service providers must consider whether a customer has made three or more transactions in 12 months when deciding if there is a business relationship, use a one-month window for linked transactions, and keep the €1,000 threshold for occasional transactions.

स्रोत: Finansinspektionen (SE FSA)

item.title: Småsparere hamstret krypto under renteuro
item.description:
Customers of Norwegian exchange Firi bought 16.1 million kroner more crypto than they sold in September, on trading of 313.5 million kroner, despite a turbulent month. Bitcoin was the top buy while many moved money out of XRP into bitcoin and solana; CEO Thuc Hoang sees rising US interest rates as the main risk.

स्रोत: Finansavisen

item.title: Ace Digital tjente 6,3 millioner kroner i tredje kvartal
item.description:
Ace Digital, listed on Euronext Growth Oslo, reported an unaudited third-quarter net profit of NOK 6.32 million, with equity up 19.3% to NOK 39.09 million and debt reduced to zero. The company says the value of its bitcoin treasury rose 373% without buying bitcoin, and estimates its economic exposure at about 57 BTC.

स्रोत: Kaupr

item.title: Representantforslag om konsesjonssystem for etablering av datasentre
item.description:
Socialist Left Party (SV) MPs have proposed in the Storting a «panic law» that would put new data centres on hold until the industry is regulated, plus a national licensing system for data centres. They also ask the government to report back quickly on how the Storting's decision to ban crypto mining in Norway will be followed up; this is a proposal, not a decision.

स्रोत: Stortinget

item.title: Rødt foreslår midlertidig stans for nye datasentre
item.description:
The Red Party (Rødt) has proposed in the Storting a temporary halt for new data centres, along with a licensing regime and other measures. Its reasoning says crypto-mining data centres get power ahead of key local industries and that the crypto-mining ban the Storting has asked for three times in two years is still not in place, though none of the proposals singles out crypto.

स्रोत: Stortinget

item.title: Så kan Sverige användas för att finansiera kärnvapen
item.description:
Crypto-assets and illegal financial networks are the biggest risks for UN sanctions against Iran and North Korea being evaded via Sweden, according to a new national risk assessment by ten Swedish authorities, Realtid reports. The authorities say organised crime has built an illegal financial infrastructure for cash, gold and conversion into crypto that could also be used for such financing. Realtid also notes that no one has been convicted of sanctions offences in Sweden in five years.

स्रोत: Realtid

item.title: Uppgifter: Tonåringar silvertejpade man i jakt på kryptovaluta
item.description:
Three teenagers, two aged 19 and one aged 16, have been arrested in Lund on suspicion of kidnapping and aggravated weapons offences, Sydsvenskan reports. According to information obtained by the newspaper, they had taken on a job to rob a local man of cryptocurrency and bound him with duct tape. Police have said little about the details and initially described the incident as a disturbance in a flat.

स्रोत: Sydsvenskan

item.title: Tiltalt for dopsalg mot kryptovaluta på det mørke nettet
item.description:
Three Norwegians and a Swede have been charged in a large drug case with links abroad, the Southern Norway public prosecutor's office says, as reported by Aftenposten. The four are linked to the sale and storage of about 135 kilos of amphetamine and methamphetamine, about 630 kilos of hashish and marijuana, about 29 kilos of cocaine and more than 200,000 pills. According to the prosecutor, much of the trade took place on the dark web, with payment in cryptocurrency.

स्रोत: Aftenposten

item.title: Kryptojätten i ny kontrovers – erbjöd tjänster i Europa utan licens
item.description:
EU supervisors are examining Binance for continuing to serve European customers without the licence required under MiCA, Realtid reports, citing the Financial Times. ESMA and national authorities in countries including France, Germany and Greece are looking at how Binance uses the narrow 'reverse solicitation' exemption, which only applies when the customer takes the initiative. Binance says it complies with applicable rules and is working towards a MiCA licence.

स्रोत: Realtid

item.title: Krypto-jätten rundar reglerna i Europa: Riskerar att kastas ut
item.description:
Binance lacks the licence required under the EU's MiCA rules and was supposed to start winding down in the EU from 1 July, yet some European customers are still trading, Dagens PS reports, citing the Financial Times. The exchange relies on the 'reverse solicitation' exemption, which ESMA says must be understood very narrowly. Authorities can request more information and, if they reject Binance's arguments, move to enforcement and fines; Binance says it follows applicable rules.

स्रोत: Dagens PS

item.title: Här är riskerna för finansiering av spridning av massförstörelsevapen störst
item.description:
Finansinspektionen reports that a new national risk assessment judges the risk of financing the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction to be highest in illegal financial activity and through the use of crypto-assets. The assessment comes from the ten authorities in Sweden's Sanctions Coordination Council. It is limited to UN Security Council resolutions with targeted financial sanctions against North Korea or Iran.

स्रोत: Finansinspektionen (SE FSA)

item.title: GreenMerc kutter 4,8 millioner i året – Northcrypto går med overskudd
item.description:
GreenMerc, the Swedish listed group behind Trijo and Finland's Northcrypto, says it has cut running costs by about SEK 400,000 a month, or around SEK 4.8 million a year, with full effect from October. According to the company, Northcrypto posted a positive operating result in July and August after Trijo's Swedish customers were moved onto its MiCA-licensed platform. The freed-up resources are being directed to Trijo One, a banking offer the company is developing with Marginalen Bank, Kaupr reports.

स्रोत: Kaupr

item.title: Pangstart for nytt kryptofond
item.description:
Gersemi Crypto Fund, a new long/short hedge fund run by former top-ranked shipping analyst Joakim Hannisdahl, is up 39 percent since it launched on 5 August, according to Hannisdahl, Finansavisen reports. The fund is driven solely by a mathematical model he keeps secret, which he says showed very high returns in backtesting. Hannisdahl stresses that the strategy is extremely volatile and carries very high risk.

स्रोत: Finansavisen

item.title: Yhteisöllisyys ja teknologia kiehtovat kryptovaluuttoihin sijoittaneita – kryptotapahtumassa iloittiin bitcoinin uudesta nousurallista
item.description:
About 700 crypto enthusiasts from Finland and abroad attended the Btchel bitcoin event at Kaapelitehdas in Helsinki, where many said community matters more to them than the bitcoin price, Yle reports. The mood was upbeat as bitcoin had risen above USD 86,000 during the week after falling to just over USD 58,000 in the summer. Nordnet told Yle that the typical crypto investor on its platform is a man aged 31 to 50.

स्रोत: Yle Uutiset (latest)

item.title: Fant hemmelig passord: Låste opp krypto-lommeboken
item.description:
Police have unlocked the crypto wallet of an NHH student in his twenties charged in a drug case, after finding a 12-word recovery phrase during a search of his home, Nettavisen reports, citing Bergensavisen. The police prosecutor says assets worth several hundred thousand kroner have been transferred from the wallet and seized. Hordaland District Court has ruled that the student will stay in custody until the trial starts in mid-November.

स्रोत: Nettavisen
